Your brain is hiding something from you... right now!
And the craziest part? You don't even notice!
Every second, your eyes receive enormous amounts of visual information.
But your brain doesn't show you everything.
It edits, filters, and fills in missing details.
In fact, each of your eyes has a BLIND SPOT where you literally cannot see!
Yet you don't notice a giant black hole in your vision.
Because your brain fills in the missing information using what's around it.
What you see isn't a perfect recording of reality.
It's your brain's best interpretation of it!
If your brain can hide a blind spot from you... what else are you missing?
